release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.3.8 Flat High-Profile Chair Deduction & Precision Release:
• Flat High-High Profile Spans: Intermediate chairs along flat high-profile spans over columns and support plates strictly inherit the high-profile chair elevation (incorporating the configured high chair deduction, e.g. 145mm instead of un-deducted raw 160mm) without rounding distortion.
• Adaptive Multi-Soffit Steps: Intermediate chairs correctly account for local formwork soffit variations across drop panels and slab step-downs.
• Robust Floor Slab Area Fallback: Enhanced net floor slab area calculation with Shoelace polygon opening deduction, guaranteeing seamless model extraction across all environments.
